d: Recruiting on behalf of: A leading training center

Talent Diamond is recruiting a qualified Accounting and Finance Trainer on behalf of a leading training center based in Jeddah. The trainer will teach financial and accounting skills to individuals, business owners, administrative staff, and corporate teams.

Course topics may include bookkeeping, accounting fundamentals, financial statements, budgeting, cash-flow management, cost control, and financial reporting. Trainers who can teach finance for non-finance professionals or use accounting software in practical exercises are encouraged to specify their expertise.

Requirements: Relevant accounting or finance qualifications and professional experience; strong knowledge of the subjects proposed; and the ability to explain financial concepts clearly. Previous training experience and experience teaching non-finance learners are preferred. Arabic and English delivery skills are an advantage.
Trainers worldwide are welcome. Please state your location, delivery languages, and availability for in-person delivery in Jeddah, online delivery, or both.
Location 6 Palace Avenue, P.O. Box 30, Manama, BahrainVIEW ON MAP
